## English

### TypeScript fix for React Native 0.87

- Fixed TypeScript errors in projects on React Native 0.87. The package ships its TypeScript source, so `tsc` in the app also checks this library, and `skipLibCheck` does not skip it. 10.58.0 failed there in three places:
  - `client.ts:980` (`AbortSignal` in the update check): failed when the project also loads DOM-style fetch types, such as `@types/bun`.
  - `setTimeout(resolve)` in `client.ts`: RN 0.87 types the timer callback as taking no arguments.
  - `global` in `core.ts`: RN 0.87's typings no longer declare it.
- Checked with `tsc` on React Native 0.87.1, react-native-tvos 0.87.1-1 and an Expo SDK 58 preview project (the template tsconfig, with `types` set to `["bun"]` or `["jest", "node"]`, and with the DOM lib).
- No runtime behavior changes. Upgrading the JS package is enough; no native rebuild is needed.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.58.0...v10.58.1)

## 中文

### React Native 0.87 的 TypeScript 修复

- 修复在 React Native 0.87 工程中出现的 TypeScript 报错。本库以 TypeScript 源码发布，所以应用里运行 `tsc` 时也会检查本库，`skipLibCheck` 不会跳过它。10.58.0 在三处会报错：
  - `client.ts:980`（检查更新时的 `AbortSignal`）：工程同时加载了 DOM 风格的 fetch 类型（例如 `@types/bun`）时报错。
  - `client.ts` 里的 `setTimeout(resolve)`：RN 0.87 把定时器回调声明为不带参数。
  - `core.ts` 里的 `global`：RN 0.87 的类型声明里已经没有它了。
- 已用 `tsc` 在 React Native 0.87.1、react-native-tvos 0.87.1-1 和 Expo SDK 58 预览版工程中验证（模板 tsconfig、`types` 设为 `["bun"]` 或 `["jest", "node"]`、使用 DOM lib）。
- 没有运行时行为变化。只需升级 JS 包，不需要重新编译原生应用。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.58.0...v10.58.1)
